title: The glome homeland
summary: The living-mountain citadel of the glomes.

claims.text: The glomes come from a huge citadel grown out of a living mountain. Three sieges have failed to take it. At its core is one of the rare sources of chimerical iron, and anyone who wants some must first survive a brutal gauntlet.

The glomes are the most hardline of the Inanimae, insisting the solimonds be driven from the Dreaming and refusing to give up the solimond homeland; the ondines lead those urging them to let old hatreds go.

title: The ways of the glomes
summary: Why the stone folk change so slowly.

claims.text: Glomes do everything deliberately, taking months to make friends or fall in or out of love, and once decided they rarely change course; a rock never changes its mind, as the saying goes.
Many glomes stay fiercely loyal to the memory of companions who left Earth in the Shattering and never came back.

title: Old wrongs among the Inanimae
summary: How a two-thousand-year grudge surfaced at an investiture.

claims.text: Ancient pacts among the Inanimae are honored by those who remember them, and wrongs done two thousand years ago can return: at Sir Mendolir of House Fiona's investiture as baron, a towering stone figure accused Mendolir of oathbreaking and of murdering the Heavy Folk.
